newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Second foreigner raises stake in El-Rov.
newsitem.headline: Second foreigner raises stake in El-Rov.

text.p: El-Rov (Israel) Ltd said on Thursday a second foreign investor in two days had raised its stake in the property development and management company to more than five percent.
"We are trying to find out who they are. We do not know what connection there is or if there is any connection," a spokesman for El-Rov told Reuters.

The company said Emerging Dolphin Ltd, a company registered in one of the British Channel islands, had acquired enough shares to raise its El-Rov stake to 5.22 percent, which under Israeli regulations makes its a major shareholder and therefore requires it to report any share transactions.
The 72,500 shares were acquired on December 10 at 13.50 shekels each, giving Dolphin a total holding of 652,575 shares.

On Tuesday, El-Rov said Quantum Emerging Growth Partners CV, a fund controlled by U.S. investor George Soros, had acquired 75,816 shares in the company on December 11. That raised Quantum's holding to 5.44 percent.
El-Rov, is 72 percent-controlled by Alfred Akirov and controls two other companies traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange -- El-Kanit Development Ltd and Adasha Development Ltd.
